Frequently asked questions

Do I need a building permit?

It depends on your country, region and municipality. We send you a checklist for your country. Please check placement and chimney with your local authority before ordering.

Does the wood stove meet local emission rules?

Rules for wood-fired stoves differ by country and region. On request we send you the technical documentation of the stove. Before use, have the stove and chimney checked according to your local rules (e.g. by a chimney sweep in Germany).

How does delivery work?

Production takes 1–3 weeks, freight 5–10 working days. Delivery on a pallet to the kerb. Delivery terms: DAP, FOB or EXW. For countries outside the EU (e.g. Switzerland, United Kingdom, USA) import duties and customs clearance are paid by the buyer; we help with the documents.

What about warranty and service?

You get a 2-year manufacturer warranty from Europaletės MB. Your statutory rights as a consumer are not affected. Details: Warranty (PDF).
